Closes #55407

body: I opened https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/55439 for this one. We have a bug here where if the path style access setting is the only setting overridden (from the client settings) in the repository settings, then it wasn't picked up (putting any other setting like e.g. the workaround as in the OP is a valid workaround here).
